brief:
Israeli colonizers accompanied by occupation forces attacked Palestinians, vehicles, and homes across several communities northeast of Ramallah on Monday evening, IMEMC News reported. Military roadblocks further restricted movement in the area during the assault.

The incidents were part of broader settler violence that has intensified in Palestinian territories, with communities in the Ramallah region facing repeated incursions and harassment from Israeli colonizers operating under military protection.

title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian communities near Ramallah
